choices.english: Truly this was the Son of God
choices.why: The adverb ἀληθῶς (truly) and the copula ἦν (was) are used to affirm the identity of the person addressed, a common formula in early Christian discourse.

choices.why: The word σχέδιον refers to a writing material, specifically a scroll, as opposed to a codex.
The verb συντάσσω implies putting things together in order, here meaning the author compiled the text.
